periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Sub-vertical orientation of the high-contrast eye patch relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval shape where the vertical length exceeds the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Downward tapering observed at the lower boundary of the eye patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Deep V-shape profile at the posterior boundary of the dark transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick lateral coverage spanning approximately 30-40% of the visible torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide spatial separation across the white cranial surface between the dark semicircular pinnae.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded semicircular curvature at the top of the ear boundaries.
